verdict.rationale: React documents components that manage their own state and re-render to match new data (react-gh-1, react-docs-3, react-docs-24). React Compiler automatically memoizes at build time, replacing manual useMemo/useCallback/React.memo, which narrows what re-runs (react-docs-15). However, the evidence shows component-level re-rendering rather than fine-grained tracking where only the dependent UI code re-runs, and the narrowing depends on an optional build-time compiler. Missing for 10: evidence of fine-grained dependency tracking that re-runs only dependent code, first-party docs on how state declaration (e.g. hooks) scopes updates, independent corroboration of update granularity.
